definition: One job a car does for a client — a duty slip's worth of driving.
The date the car went on duty. Decides which month's invoice the trip goes into.
The date printed on the invoice itself.
The From/To dates used to pick which trips go on an invoice.
What you charge one client for one car type.
A fixed-hours, fixed-km package for same-city driving, e.g. 80 km / 8 hrs.
The per-km charge once a local trip goes beyond its package's included kilometres.
The per-hour charge once a local trip goes beyond its package's included hours.
Out-of-city travel, billed per kilometre instead of a fixed package.
Road toll paid during a trip, added as a charge on the invoice.
State entry tax or permit fee, added as a charge on the invoice.
Parking fees paid during a trip, added as a charge on the invoice.
A business's 15-character GST registration number.
Central GST — half of the tax charged when the client is in your own state.
State GST — the other half of the tax charged when the client is in your own state.
Integrated GST — the tax charged when the client is in a different state.
Reverse charge — the client pays GST themselves instead of you.
To give an invoice its permanent number. Once issued, its lines are frozen.
An invoice saved but not yet issued — no number given yet, fully editable.
Cancels an issued invoice. It stays on record marked Undone, and its trips become free to re-bill.
